content:
# Comstar overlay MCP — AO catalog metadata + COMSTAR tunnel bootstrap fields.
# Reach OverlayPacker does not read this file; ComstarMcpBootstrap / mcp_yaml.dart does.
# Session MCP id becomes client.nextcloud via tunnel://session-mcp/nextcloud.
id: nextcloud
description: >
  Nextcloud (files, notes, calendar, tasks, contacts, mail) via Reach stdio tunnel
capabilities: >
  WebDAV files; Notes CRUD/search; CalDAV events + todos; CardDAV contacts;
  Nextcloud Mail. Tool playbooks: nextcloud_voice + nc_*_voice skills.
good_for: nextcloud, files, notes, calendar, tasks, contacts, mail, nas, cloud
planner_hint: >
  Attach for Nextcloud / home-cloud questions when the resident is linked.
  Not Google Workspace — different account.
user_goal_keywords:
  - nextcloud
  - cloud
  - nas
  - notes
  - files
  - documents
  - calendar
  - tasks
  - contacts
  - mail

# COMSTAR bridge bootstrap (not AO stdio/streamable_http)
transport: stdio_tunnel
alias: nextcloud
# Prefer uvx; bootstrap falls back to PATH nextcloud-mcp-server if uvx missing.
command:
  - uvx
  - nextcloud-mcp-server@0.166.0
  - run
  - --transport
  - stdio
env_from:
  - NEXTCLOUD_HOST
  - NEXTCLOUD_USERNAME
  - NEXTCLOUD_PASSWORD
requires_tokens: true
guest_allowed: false
